description_en: Queries the synchronization scope, validity of selected departments, and scope statistics of the configured DingTalk or Lark identity provider for a user pool
description_zh: 查询用户池已配置的钉钉或飞书身份源的同步范围、所选部门有效性及范围统计结果
name: GetIdentityProviderSyncScope

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool. The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length, start with a letter or a digit, and contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 用户池名称。长度为3～64个字符，以字母或数字开头，其余字符仅允许字母、数字、下划线和短划线
parameters.name: user_pool_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity provider. This parameter is case-sensitive. DingTalk indicates DingTalk, and Feishu indicates Lark
parameters.help_zh: 身份源类型，区分大小写。DingTalk表示钉钉，Feishu表示飞书
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

schema.description_en: The response returned when the API operation is successful
schema.description_zh: 接口调用成功时的返回结果

EstimateStatus.description_en: The scope statistics status. Valid values: Ready (the statistics are ready), Computing (background calculation is in progress), and Failed (the statistics calculation failed). In all-user mode, Ready is directly returned, but the two statistical counts are not returned. This status is not the user synchronization task status
EstimateStatus.description_zh: 范围统计状态。Ready表示已就绪，Computing表示后台计算中，Failed表示统计失败。全员模式直接返回Ready，但不返回两个统计数字。该状态不是人员同步任务状态

EstimatedUserCount.description_en: The statistical value of the user count returned when the statistics are ready in specified department mode. Users duplicated across departments may be counted multiple times, or the most recent synchronization result for the same scope may be used. This parameter is not returned in all-user mode, during calculation, or when statistics calculation fails. An absent value does not indicate 0
EstimatedUserCount.description_zh: 指定部门模式下，统计就绪时返回的用户数统计值。跨部门重复用户可能重复计数，也可能使用同一范围最近一次同步结果。全员模式、计算中或统计失败时不返回；缺省不代表0

ExpandedDepartmentCount.description_en: The deduplicated count of expanded departments returned when the statistics are ready in specified department mode, including the selected departments and their descendants. This parameter is not returned in all-user mode, during calculation, or when statistics calculation fails. An absent value does not indicate 0
ExpandedDepartmentCount.description_zh: 指定部门模式下，统计就绪时返回的去重展开部门数，包含选中部门及其后代。全员模式、计算中或统计失败时不返回；缺省不代表0

RequestId.description_en: The request ID used to locate and troubleshoot the current API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，用于定位和排查本次调用

SelectedDepartments.description_en: The details of the selected departments in the configuration, not the full list of expanded departments. An empty array is returned in all-user mode
SelectedDepartments.description_zh: 配置中选中的部门明细，不是全部展开部门列表。全员模式返回空数组

items.description_en: The current name and validity information of a selected department
items.description_zh: 一个已选部门的当前名称与有效性信息

Exists.description_en: Indicates whether the department still exists. false is returned only when it is confirmed that the department does not exist. Query errors such as permission or network issues are not treated as the department not existing
Exists.description_zh: 部门是否仍存在。只有确认部门不存在时返回false；权限、网络等查询错误不会被当作部门不存在

Id.description_en: The identifier of the selected department in the configuration. This identifier is retained even if the department no longer exists
Id.description_zh: 配置中选中的部门标识。即使部门已不存在，也保留该标识

Name.description_en: The name of the department. This parameter can be omitted if the department does not exist
Name.description_zh: 部门名称。部门不存在时可省略

SyncScope.description_en: The currently saved synchronization scope configuration
SyncScope.description_zh: 当前已保存的同步范围配置

DepartmentIds.description_en: The list of identifiers of the selected departments in the configuration. This field is not required in all-user mode and may be omitted in the response
DepartmentIds.description_zh: 配置中选中的部门标识列表。全员模式下不需要该字段，响应中可能省略

items.description_en: The identifier of a selected department in the configuration
items.description_zh: 配置中选中的一个部门标识

Mode.description_en: The synchronization scope mode. Valid values: AllAuthorized (all users within the authorized visibility scope of the third-party application) and SelectedDepartments (the specified departments and all their descendant departments)
Mode.description_zh: 同步范围模式。AllAuthorized表示第三方应用授权可见范围内的全部用户；SelectedDepartments表示指定部门及其全部后代部门
